observations: body L1-L5: the sentence begun on p. 319. «so-» and «defi-» have hyphens (2.6 and 2.0 pt). «al–Battānī» (L2) and «pater» are letter-spaced; «al–Battānī» (L4) is not. The dashes of «al–Battānī» (L2, L4) and «al–Fihrist» measure 5.6, 5.4 and 5.4 pt. A speck after «qua» (L3) is not transcribed.

body L5: Schiaparelli's figure of the armillary sphere stands under this line, centred, and is redrawn from the print as the traced outline of its ink, at 1200 dpi (the scan is of 600 dpi) and within 0.08 pt: the rings with their graduations, the shaded globe, the axis SS with its screws, the sighting rule with its pinnules and the dotted ray from the Sun, the dotted equator and ecliptic and the dash-dot lines; the blanks inside the strokes are left open. The letters S, D, E, G, F, C, B, A, H and L are set as text in bold italic, each scaled to its printed ink; the upper D, the F, the three A and the H in the middle touch lines of the drawing and are parted from them along short cuts. The words Aequator, Ecliptica, Colurus, aequinoct. and Polus stay with the drawing, since their letters touch the dots and ticks of the lines along which they stand; a second word under Polus is covered by the shading of the globe and cannot be read.

notes_left L1-L7: the Greek is set as printed, «Ὄργανον ἀστρολάβον» and «Στερεὰ σφαῖρα»; the circumflex of «σφαῖρα» prints as a dot. «Ptolemaei», «Procli», «Tannery» and «Ptol.» are letter-spaced. The places are Almagest V, 1, the construction of the astrolabe with its rings, and VIII, 3, the solid globe. «70-73» and «92-97» have hyphens (3.1 and 4.1 pt); the hyphen of «l’hi-» measures 1.4 pt.

notes_right L1-L7: «al-Fihrist» (L1) has a hyphen (3.4 pt), as have «Mathematiker-Verzeich-» (3.7 pt) and «41-42» (3.5 pt); «H. Suter» is letter-spaced. The a of «Kitāb» has its macron as a short slanting stroke.
